page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9it.4xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the Enhanced family, hosted on the KVM hypervisor. The instance is equipped with 16 dedicated vCPUs powered by x86_64 Intel Xeon 6982P-C processors running at a base clock speed of 3.2 GHz. Memory is provisioned at 64.0 GB of system RAM, maintaining a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio with 4.0 GB allocation per core. The hardware profile does not include integrated graphical processing units (0 GPUs) or onboard local storage disks, necessitating remote network-attached block storage for system and application data.

Networking capabilities on the instance provide a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps, supporting stable throughput for data transport and distributed service communication. Because the instance relies entirely on external storage and provides no ephemeral NVMe volumes, disk I/O performance depends on network-attached storage tiers. The dedicated vCPU topology delivers predictable compute execution without noisy-neighbor contention. With its balanced core-to-memory configuration and 20 Gbps network profile, the ecs.g9it.4xlarge instance is suited for multi-tier web serving, intermediate relational and memory databases, container orchestration nodes, microservices architectures, and backend enterprise application processing.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9it.4xlarge is an Enhanced general-purpose instance featuring 16 dedicated vCPUs driven by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at 3.2 GHz. The instance supplies 64.0 GB of system memory, matching a balanced 4.0 GB per vCPU distribution suitable for broad workload patterns. It includes 20 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth to facilitate high-throughput communication across cloud infrastructure. The instance incorporates no local storage and no dedicated graphics accelerators, which means persistent storage operations require external network-attached volumes. This architecture provides steady, dedicated CPU performance free from multi-tenant CPU stealing, though workloads requiring low-latency scratch disks must adapt to network storage constraints. Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9it.4xlarge fits general enterprise applications, middle-tier web servers, CI/CD runners, containerized clusters, and distributed microservices platforms.
